items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: well that's where a fellow by the name of Oriel Fusche, he left our band, the Young Tuxedo, and went into the Sam Morgan band

ctx.x: On the old-time bands, there's not room for a piano.

Yeah, you see, the old-time bandstand, of course, the Carparelli's Hall is the, I don't know, they didn't knock that down. Yeah, the Carparelli's Hall, that's to be on Liberty Street. That used to be another famous hall, but now the Sandus Cinders had a piano on their bandstand. You see, now you can line up a band, when the Sandus Cinders, the piano beat mostly to the back wall, then you put your drummer there, and you put your banjo on that side. Most likely banjo player had to be almost like on the left side of…
I want to ask you something more about the Morgan band. How long did Gaynor play with that band?
